_comment: How the data plane refuses a capability it did not issue, which the server and both SDKs' fakes are held to: each case is a token presented to get_object, and the answer it gets. {foreign_token} and {foreign_biscuit} are a capability token and its Biscuit from an issuer this server does not trust. The code and the reason hold for every implementation; the message, where given, is the server's library's words, which paladintest gives too and paladin.testing does not mirror: much of it is Go's own wording of a decoding error.

cases.name: not a Biscuit
cases.message: invalid token: biscuit encoding: illegal base64 data at input byte 8

cases.name: not a JWT
cases.message: invalid token: decode header: illegal base64 data at input byte 0

cases.name: an untyped JWT
cases.message: invalid token: typ "" is not one of ["limes-cap-v6+jwt" "at+jwt"]
